title: BRDF Deferred Rendering
description: A deferred PBR rendering pipeline for Defold with tiled light culling, shadows, tone mapping and post-processing, shown in a walkable interior. By Mikhail Martianov.
author: martianovdev
credits: CC BY 4.0: this cart is a redistribution of the project at the pinned commit with the changes in patches/, credited to Mikhail Martianov (martianov.tech).
notes: WebGPU: patches/ rewrites the shaders that pass sampler2D to functions (WGSL has no sampler parameters: lighting_shadow.glsl, eevee_lighting.glsl and model.fp read their uniforms directly, so model.material names its shadow sampler texture_shadowmap like the other passes), samples with an explicit LOD where WGSL requires uniform control flow (SSAO, tile masks, shadow atlas; the targets have no mips, so the result is unchanged), and widens the scalar/vec3 fragment outputs to vec4 with alpha 1 (every pass draws with blending on, and WebGPU will not blend from an output without alpha; GL renders byte-identically).
